data.summary:
Its **transport capacity** is 45 models, all **ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY**, plus 2 **DREADNOUGHT** models. Some models fill more than 1 space:

- **JUMP PACK**, **GRAVIS** and **TERMINATOR** models: 2 each
- **CENTURION** models: 3 each
- **DREADNOUGHT** models: as many as their **W** characteristic

The text lists the 2 **DREADNOUGHT** models beside the 45 yet also gives them a space cost, so whether they count against the 45 is open. It also names **ADEPTUS ASTARTES** models, not **HERETIC ASTARTES** ones, so which models of this army can embark is open.
